name: What is a tenant improvement allowance?

mainEntity.name: What is a tenant improvement allowance?

acceptedAnswer.text: A tenant improvement allowance (TIA) is a sum of money provided by the landlord to the tenant to help fund the build-out or renovation of a leased commercial space. This allowance is usually negotiated as part of the lease agreement and can be structured in various ways, such as a fixed amount per square foot. The tenant typically manages the project, hires contractors, and submits invoices to the landlord for reimbursement, up to the agreed-upon allowance.
acceptedAnswer.description: A tenant improvement allowance (TIA) is a landlord-provided fund to help a tenant cover renovation costs in a leased commercial space, negotiated as part of the lease.
